fare.reason: Fares in the source feed date from 2018 and are no longer accurate. Showing a wrong price is worse than showing none.

note: No data for the origin and destination. Coverage is Greater Cairo only (roughly lat 29.75-30.35, lon 30.85-31.78); no other part of Egypt has transit data yet.
